ai.literal: Goodness and evil having examined, the one of a nature that chose the good, to be employed will be.
ai.translation: He who carefully weighs both the good and the bad in any matter, and possesses the character to choose the good, is the one who should be employed.
ai.modern: நன்மையையும் தீமையையும் ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்து, நன்மையானவற்றையே விரும்பும் குணமுடையவனே ஒரு செயலைச் செய்ய ஆளப்பட வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the key qualification for selecting an agent or employee. A wise leader must choose someone who does not act blindly but instead analyzes both the positive benefits (nanmai) and negative consequences (theemai) of an action. The ideal candidate is one whose character (thanmai) naturally inclines them to choose and practice what is good (nalam). Such a person of balanced judgment and moral preference is fit to be entrusted with duties.

ai.literal: Revenue having increased, wealth having developed, the obstacles that arise he who investigates, let him do the work.
ai.translation: Let the person who can increase revenues, develop prosperity, and foresee and investigate the obstacles that may arise, perform the task.
ai.modern: வருவாயைப் பெருக்கி, வளத்தை உண்டாக்கி, வரக்கூடிய இடையூறுகளை ஆராய்ந்து நீக்க வல்லவனே அந்தச் செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualifications of an agent chosen to execute a task. The ideal person must be capable of increasing the sources of revenue (வாரி பெருக்கி) and developing overall prosperity and resources (வளம்படுத்து). Crucially, they must also have the foresight to anticipate, analyze, and resolve any obstacles or difficulties that may arise during the execution of the work (உற்றவை ஆராய்வான்). Only a person possessing these three capabilities should be entrusted with performing the task (செய்க வினை).

ai.literal: Love, knowledge, clarity of mind, absence of desire—these four, only with him who fully possesses them, lies trust.
ai.translation: Trust should be placed only in that person who fully possesses these four qualities: love, knowledge, clarity of mind, and freedom from greed.
ai.modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, தெளிந்த சிந்தனை, பேராசை இல்லாமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கையும் நன்றாகப் பெற்றிருப்பவனிடமே நம்பிக்கை வைக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the four essential qualities a leader must look for when choosing an officer. These are: affection (அன்பு) towards others, wisdom (அறிவு) to make right choices, clarity of mind (தேற்றம்) to act without doubt, and freedom from greed (அவாவின்மை) to prevent corruption. Only in a person who possesses all four of these virtues fully (நன்குடையான்) should one place absolute trust (தெளிவு). The word 'தேற்றம்' specifically denotes a clear, unwavering mind that is free from confusion, which is crucial for executive action.

words.gloss: by the nature of the action

ai.literal: Even when examined and trusted in every possible way, those who become different by the nature of the action are many people.
ai.translation: Even after being tested and trusted in every possible way, there are many people who change their nature when confronted with the actual demands of a task.
ai.modern: எந்த வழிகளில் ஆராய்ந்து தெளிந்த போதிலும், செய்யும் செயலின் தன்மையால் வேறுபட்டுப் போகும் மனிதர்கள் பலர் இருக்கிறார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights a practical challenge in selecting people for tasks. A person might pass every test of character, loyalty, and capability beforehand. However, when they are assigned a specific task, the pressure, temptations, or nature of that work can cause them to change and behave differently. The poet warns that initial trust is not a guarantee of final performance, as many people alter their behavior under the influence of actual responsibility.

ai.literal: Other than to one who is capable of doing, having understood and having performed, a task indeed is not of the nature of being assigned thinking that 'he is a beloved person'.
ai.translation: A task should not be entrusted to someone merely because they are a beloved associate; it must only be assigned to one who fully understands it, knows how to overcome obstacles, and has the capability to execute it.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலை நன்கு அறிந்து, வரும் இடையூறுகளைத் தாங்கி, அதைச் செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவரிடமே அச்செயலை ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்; அவர் நமக்கு நெருக்கமானவர் என்று கருதி அவரிடம் அச்செயலை ஒப்படைக்கக் கூடாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the danger of favoritism and the necessity of competence when delegating responsibilities. The author argues that a task must only be assigned to someone who has analyzed it thoroughly, knows how to handle difficulties, and possesses the practical ability to execute it. It is a mistake to entrust a duty to someone simply because they are a close friend or beloved associate. True governance and successful action rely on choosing the right person for the job based on merit, not personal affection.

ai.literal: Having examined the doer, having examined the work, and having understood how they fit with the right time, perform it.
ai.translation: Examine the agent, examine the enterprise, and having understood how they fit with the proper time, execute the task.
ai.modern: செயலைச் செய்பவனை ஆராய்ந்து, செய்ய வேண்டிய செயலையும் ஆராய்ந்து, அச்செயலைச் செய்வதற்குப் பொருத்தமான காலத்தையும் அறிந்து அச்செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential factors a leader must analyze before executing any task: the person, the work, and the timing. First, one must evaluate the capability and character of the person chosen for the job. Second, the nature, challenges, and requirements of the work itself must be assessed. Finally, the leader must understand how the task and the doer align with the right timing before initiating the action.

ai.literal: This [task], by this [means], this person will accomplish, thus having analyzed, that [task] to him leaving.
ai.translation: After analyzing, 'This person can accomplish this task by these means,' then entrust that duty to him.
ai.modern: இந்தப் பணியை, இந்த வழியால், இவன் செய்து முடிப்பான் என்று ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்து, அந்தப் பணியை அவனிடம் ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the fundamental principle of delegation and human resource management. A leader must first analyze the task itself and determine the exact means or resources required to complete it. Then, the leader must evaluate the capability of the specific individual to see if they can successfully execute it. Only after a thorough investigation of these three factors should the responsibility be fully entrusted to that person.

ai.literal: For the task fitness having examined after, him for that as the fit person should make.
ai.translation: After examining a person's fitness for a task, one should appoint him as the person responsible for that task.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்வதற்கு ஒருவனுடைய தகுதியை ஆராய்ந்த பிறகு, அவனை அச்செயலுக்கு உரியவனாக ஆக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the essential rule of delegation. First, a leader must carefully examine a person's capability and suitability ('உரிமை நாடிய') for a specific task. Only after this thorough assessment ('பின்றை') should the leader entrust the work to them. Finally, the leader must fully empower that person, making them the sole authority ('உரியனாகச் செயல்') for that task to ensure its successful completion.

ai.literal: In the execution of a task, him who thinks differently of the friendship of the one who has the capability for that task, Fortune will depart from.
ai.translation: Fortune will depart from a leader who doubts the loyalty of an efficient worker who is fully dedicated to his task.
ai.modern: ஒரு தொழிலைச் செய்வதில் வல்லமை உடையவனுடைய நட்பை, வேறுபட்டு (சந்தேகப்பட்டு) நினைக்கும் தலைவனை விட்டுச் செல்வம் நீங்கும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the danger of harboring suspicion against capable and dedicated workers. 'Vinaiyutaiyan' refers to a person who has the skill and drive to execute a task. If a leader doubts ('veraka ninaippan') the loyalty or friendship ('kenmai') of such a worker while they are engaged in their work ('vinaikkan'), the Goddess of Fortune ('Thiru') will abandon that leader. Trust is essential for successful delegation, and groundless suspicion only drives away prosperity.

ai.literal: Daily let examine the king the worker's unswerving conduct; [if so,] will not swerve the world.
ai.translation: Let the king daily examine the conduct of his officers; as long as they do not swerve from their duty, the world will not swerve from its path.
ai.modern: அரசன் தன் தொழிலைச் செய்பவனுடைய நேர்மையை நாள்தோறும் ஆராய வேண்டும்; அவன் கோணாமல் கடமை ஆற்றினால், உலகமும் தன் நல்ல நிலையிலிருந்து கோணாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the importance of constant supervision in governance. The king (மன்னன்) must daily (நாடோறும்) watch and evaluate (நாடுக) the integrity and unswerving nature (கோடாமை) of his officers (வினைசெய்வான்). If the administrators perform their duties uprightly without bending the rules, the subjects of the world (உலகு) will also remain orderly and will not go astray (கோடாது). The stability of the entire society depends on this daily vigilance over those who hold executive power.
